answer: Decentralized consensus crystallizes trust like subterranean mycelium weaving beneath a barren tundra, shifting sand dune, and ivory mineral spire. By staking verifiable computational proofs weighted by web-of-trust endorsements, validation rights interconnect organically. Faking myriad identities imposes a superlinear attacker cost: collateral burns scale exponentially per duplicated bond, starving synthetic swarms before they root.
